build: Uncommitted local snapshot; not a release
changes: Policy picker location context, relevant areas and labels, selected-empty choices and keyboard focus
Monitoring issue badges clarify shared scope without inflating unique issue counts
Notifications ordered by timing with confirmed saves returning to their list
Fresh module and element identities for existing browser sessions
test_repairs: The broader browser fixture battery now belongs to the kitchen area and phones label expected by its save scenario.
The picker scenario uses the visible responsive Back control.

validation.required_quick: 541 frontend tests; Ruff, formatting and JavaScript syntax checks passed
validation.picker: 27 focused picker tests passed before final quick checks
validation.upgrade: Previous panel30/card26 registrations remain intact and current panel31/card27 use updated code
